questions.question_text: Explain two reasons why teamworking could help Tessalit Assembly Ltd.
questions.model_answer: Reason 1: Teamworking builds cooperation between staff [k], because the 96 production staff are already organised into 12 cells of 8, so cells can share skills and cover each other on the line [app]. Reason 2: It supports quality improvement [k], because teams that own their cells are more likely to cut the 2.1% defect rate below 1.5% [app].

knowledge_max_2: cooperation and mutual support in cells
shared ownership improves quality outcomes

questions.question_text: Explain two advantages of a team-based bonus rather than an individual piece rate.
questions.model_answer: Benefit 1: The team bonus rewards cooperation [k], because $4,000 per year per cell is paid only if the cell's defect rate falls below 1.5% [app], so workers help each other and quality rises, not just individual speed [an]. Benefit 2: The cost is capped and predictable [k], because 12 cells all qualifying would cost $48,000 a year [app], unlike a $0.24 piece rate whose total cost grows as output rises [an].

knowledge_max_2: team bonus rewards cooperation and quality
capped, predictable cost vs variable piece rate
analysis_max_2: cooperation lifts quality without forcing individual speed
fixed bonus budget avoids runaway piece rate cost

questions.question_text: Do you think Tessalit Assembly Ltd should introduce the team-based bonus rather than an individual piece rate of $0.24 per machine? Justify your answer.
questions.model_answer: A team-based bonus would improve quality and cooperation [k], because cells must hit a defect rate below 1.5% to earn $4,000 each [app], directly attacking the 2.1% defect rate behind rework on 150,000 washing machines [an]. However, an individual piece rate gives the strongest individual incentive [k], because $0.24 per completed machine pays only for output produced [app], so faster workers across the 12 cells earn more and total output could rise [an]. Overall, the team bonus is the better choice [eval], because the factory's priority is cutting the 2.1% defect rate and building cell cooperation, not simply faster individual assembly [eval].

knowledge_max_2: team bonus drives quality and cooperation
piece rate drives individual output
application_max_2: defect rate below 1.5% earns $4,000 per cell
analysis_max_2: bonus directly attacks rework on high volumes
piece rate raises individual pace and total output
evaluation_max_2: weighs quality/cooperation priority against output incentive
